name: [WE'RE BACK!]  Dummy Wars: A New Chapter
desc:
one last Redux to current anc, bringing chapter 1 (and celebration chaos) to our standards for chapter 2 has been done!
Most units are rebalanced to be better, while a few things that were disastrous for balance were replaced.
there's also skins, so you can spend your stockpile of upgrade points!

____________________________________
!!! alot of music is from artists such as pittsborne, DM DOKURO, and randominciguess! please support them! !!!
shutdown = update!

console controls: 
LB/RB = left/right
X/B = attack/defend
Y = statue ability

Dummy Wars: A New Chapter is a Official retake and continuation of the original Dummy Wars from 
Saucefy10, where you send units to fight enemies and unlock more statues and units!

Like the original Dummy Wars, Inspired by Stick War: Legacy and The Battle Bricks. 
Updates may not be frequent, because this is a two person project when it comes to developing.
 
official soundtrack is in the community server!
